provenance.definition: Static KITTI-era detector constants already documented in emod/configs/od_cfg.py; reordered from Pedestrian,Car,Cyclist to Vehicle,Pedestrian,Cyclist.
provenance.data_dependence: No DSEC, SE3D, held-out or excluded training labels are used to compute these constants.
provenance.usage: Use only when a class has zero raw boxes in a chosen training subset; identical fallback in scratch and pretrained arms. Present classes always use their subset-only medians.
